newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower, tracking Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower, tracking Chicago.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower on Friday, pressured by the weaker Chicago market overnight and the yen's rebound against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 130 yen to 260 yen lower, with the benchmark May 1998 contract down 180 yen at 15,710 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 50,708 lots.
Prices moved within narrow ranges for most of the day, with most players sidelined ahead of the G7 meeting this weekend.
The spot May contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was trading at $2.94 per bushel at 0827 GMT, up from $2.93 at Thursday's close.
Spot May CBOT soybean futures were at $8.48 a bushel, up from $8.47 at Thursday's close.
